notes: The scribe's name, 'śrīhemā〇krana', is corrupt; the 〇 is a string-hole or space mark. It most likely stands for Hemākareṇa (instrumental), giving the stem Hemākara. This reading is not certain. The residence is also corrupt. 'sayava tolake' is a locality (tol). '(tarumura)mahāvihāra' is the cataloguer's bracketed reading and may be Tarumūla Mahāvihāra. 'raraṃkṛtavihāra' may be a corruption of Alaṃkṛta-vihāra. The house is described as on the southern side ('dakṣanadisa'). I did not normalise the place because the identification is uncertain. Tarumūla Mahāvihāra may be Sikhamu Bahi in Kathmandu, but I have not checked this. The catalogue fields are empty, so nothing conflicts with them. No king, donor or commissioner is named.
